description: This Java source file defines the @Immutable exception class 'ThingNotCreatableException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project to signal errors related to creating 'Thing' entities when certain policies are missing or creation fails.

classes.name: ThingNotCreatableException
classes.description: A final, immutable exception class indicating failure to create a 'Thing' due to missing or failed policy associations, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing ThingException.

classes.name: ThingNotCreatableException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class providing a fluent API to construct instances of 'ThingNotCreatableException' with specific context such as missing policy or creation failure.

methods.name: newBuilderForPolicyMissing
methods.description: Creates a builder for a 'ThingNotCreatableException' indicating a missing linked policy ID during 'Thing' creation.

methods.name: newBuilderForPolicyExisting
methods.description: Creates a builder for a 'ThingNotCreatableException' indicating a failure in creating an implicit policy during 'Thing' creation.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs a 'ThingNotCreatableException' using an explicit message, description, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a 'ThingNotCreatableException' from a JSON object and headers, extracting error details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of 'ThingNotCreatableException' with updated headers.
